select.if:
SELECT ftl.flow_id,ftl.template_id,ftl.cur_link,ftl.link_type,ftl.pre_link,ftl.next_link, if(flic.link_alias is null,flc.link_name,flic.link_alias) linkName, flic.alarm_flow_id,afc.alarm_flow_name,flic.msg_notify_type,flic.user_type,flic.id as attr_id,flic.id as flowAttrId, ftl.real_link_type realLinkType,
(select group_concat(DISTINCT(role_id)) from vm_flow_link_role as flr WHERE flr.link_id = flic.link_id and flr.attr_id = flic.id and flr.grid_sign ='0') as roleId, (select group_concat(DISTINCT(user_id)) from vm_flow_link_user as flu WHERE flu.link_id = flic.link_id and flu.attr_id = flic.id and flu.grid_sign ='0') as userId,
(select group_concat(DISTINCT(role_id)) from vm_flow_link_role as flr WHERE flr.link_id = flic.link_id and flr.attr_id = flic.id) as roleId, (select group_concat(DISTINCT(user_id)) from vm_flow_link_user as flu WHERE flu.link_id = flic.link_id and flu.attr_id = flic.id ) as userId,
flic.data_filter_permiss dataFilterPermiss FROM vm_flow_template_link ftl INNER JOIN vm_flow_link_config flc ON ftl.cur_link = flc.link_id INNER JOIN vm_alarm_flow_config afc ON ftl.template_id = afc.template_id LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_attr flic ON ftl.cur_link = flic.link_id and flic.alarm_flow_id=afc.id WHERE afc.id = #{alarmFlowId} AND ftl.link_type = '1'

SELECT ftl.flow_id,ftl.template_id,ftl.cur_link,ftl.link_type,ftl.pre_link,ftl.next_link,flc.link_name,flic.msg_notify_type, ftl.cur_link as realLinkType,
flic.role_id as roleId,
(select CONCAT(IFNULL(flic.role_id,''), ',', IFNULL(flic.grid_sign_role,''))) as roleId,
flic.data_filter_permiss dataFilterPermiss FROM vm_flow_template_link ftl INNER JOIN vm_flow_link_config flc ON ftl.cur_link = flc.link_id LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_industry_config flic ON ftl.cur_link = flic.link_id
AND flic.industry_code is null
WHERE ftl.delete_flag = '0' and flic.delete_flag='0'
AND flic.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND flic.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} AND flic.delete_flag = '0'
and ftl.template_id = #{templateId} AND ftl.link_type = '1'

SELECT ftl.flow_id,ftl.template_id,ftl.cur_link,ftl.link_type,ftl.pre_link,ftl.next_link,flc.link_name,flic.msg_notify_type,flic.role_id,flic.notify_admin_flag,flic.leader_flag,'2' as userType FROM vm_flow_template_link ftl INNER JOIN vm_flow_link_config flc ON ftl.cur_link = flc.link_id LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_industry_config flic ON ftl.cur_link = flic.link_id
AND flic.industry_code is null
WHERE ftl.delete_flag = 0
AND flic.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND flic.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} AND flic.delete_flag = '0'
and ftl.template_id = #{templateId}
AND ftl.cur_link = #{linkId}
AND ftl.real_link_type = #{realLinkType} and ftl.link_type='1'

mapper.select: select distinct template_id from vm_flow_template_industry where template_id = #{templateId} and industry_code = #{industryCode} AND app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} AND delete_flag = '0' AND status = '1'
